subtopics.label: Glioma Molecular Biology and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research into the molecular, epigenetic, and cellular mechanisms driving glioma and glioblastoma, including tumor microenvironment interactions, glioma stem cell biology, chromatin remodeling, and transcriptional cell states.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic, cellular, and stem cell mechanisms driving glioma, including tumor microenvironment interactions and transcriptional cell states.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma and High-Grade Glioma Treatment Strategies
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational studies on treatment of glioblastoma and high-grade gliomas, including chemotherapy, radiation, immunotherapy combinations, targeted agents, and novel therapeutic approaches such as CHI3L1 inhibitors and IDH inhibitors.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and translational studies on chemotherapy, radiation, immunotherapy, and targeted agents for glioblastoma and high-grade gliomas.

subtopics.label: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma and Convection-Enhanced Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies focused on diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) treatment using convection-enhanced delivery (CED), including pharmacokinetics, dosimetry, drug formulations, and clinical trials of agents such as 124I-omburtamab and DM1.
subtopics.short_description: Treatment of diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma via convection-enhanced delivery, covering pharmacokinetics, dosimetry, and clinical drug trials.

subtopics.label: Meningioma Imaging, Radiosurgery, and Medical Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on meningioma diagnosis and management using DOTATATE PET/MRI, radiosurgery planning, radiation therapy outcomes, novel medical therapies, and neurocognitive impact of intracranial meningiomas.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and management of meningioma using DOTATATE PET/MRI, radiosurgery planning, and novel medical therapies.

subtopics.label: Pediatric CNS Tumor Biology, Diagnosis, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric brain tumors including medulloblastoma, ATRT, choroid plexus carcinoma, and low-grade gliomas, covering molecular profiling, classification, novel therapeutics, and leptomeningeal dissemination.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular profiling, classification, and therapeutics for pediatric CNS tumors including medulloblastoma, ATRT, and low-grade gliomas.

subtopics.label: Glioma Molecular Classification and Diagnostic Markers
subtopics.description: Research on molecular diagnostic tools and classification of gliomas, including IDH mutation detection, MGMT methylation, WHO classification updates, and machine learning-based histopathological prediction of tumor genotype.
subtopics.short_description: IDH mutation detection, MGMT methylation, WHO classification, and machine learning-based histopathological genotype prediction in gliomas.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Techniques for Brain Tumor Characterization
subtopics.description: Development and application of advanced MRI methods including DCE-MRI, diffusion kurtosis imaging, radiomic analysis, and ACE-MRI for tumor characterization, treatment response assessment, and pseudoprogression prediction in gliomas and other CNS tumors.
subtopics.short_description: DCE-MRI, diffusion kurtosis, and radiomic methods for CNS tumor characterization, treatment response, and pseudoprogression assessment.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgical Approaches and Techniques
subtopics.description: Anatomical and technical studies on surgical approaches to the skull base, including frontotemporal, transpetrosal, far lateral, and cavernous sinus approaches for resection of tumors and vascular lesions.
subtopics.short_description: Anatomical and technical studies on frontotemporal, transpetrosal, far lateral, and cavernous sinus approaches for tumor and vascular lesion resection.

subtopics.label: Intraoperative Neurophysiology and Awake Craniotomy
subtopics.description: Research on intraoperative techniques for brain tumor surgery including motor cortex mapping with bipolar stimulation, awake craniotomy with antiseizure medication management, and augmented reality-assisted resection.
subtopics.short_description: Motor cortex mapping, awake craniotomy techniques, and augmented reality-assisted resection for brain tumor surgery.

subtopics.label: Brain Metastases: Imaging, Treatment, and Multidisciplinary Care
subtopics.description: Studies on the management of brain metastases from systemic cancers, including PET-based imaging with FES and DOTATATE, pharmacological treatment trials, and multidisciplinary care pathways to optimize time to adjuvant irradiation.
subtopics.short_description: PET-based imaging, pharmacological trials, and multidisciplinary care pathways for brain metastases from systemic cancers.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Drug Delivery and Focused Ultrasound
subtopics.description: Research on strategies to overcome the blood-brain barrier for CNS tumor therapy, including focused ultrasound-enhanced drug delivery, intraarterial administration, and convection-enhanced delivery of novel agents.
subtopics.short_description: Focused ultrasound, intraarterial administration, and convection-enhanced delivery strategies to overcome the blood-brain barrier for CNS therapy.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma Disease Models and Preclinical Research
subtopics.description: Development and use of preclinical models for glioblastoma and other CNS tumors, including patient-derived cerebral organoids, 3D spheroid models, and in vivo mouse glioma models for therapeutic testing.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cerebral organoids, 3D spheroid models, and in vivo mouse glioma systems for preclinical therapeutic testing.

subtopics.label: CNS Lymphoma, Craniopharyngioma, and Rare Brain Tumors
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on rare CNS tumors including primary CNS lymphoma (EBV-positive), craniopharyngioma with hypothalamic involvement, colloid cysts, and pituitary neoplasms with somatostatin receptor expression.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical studies on primary CNS lymphoma, craniopharyngioma, colloid cysts, and pituitary neoplasms with somatostatin receptor expression.

subtopics.label: Neuro-Oncology Rehabilitation and Functional Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation and functional recovery in patients with brain and spinal cord tumors, including inpatient rehabilitation after glioblastoma resection, spine tumor rehabilitation, and neuropsychological care in neurosurgical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Inpatient rehabilitation, spine tumor recovery, and neuropsychological care for patients with brain and spinal cord tumors.
